verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a general Marketing API, a 'Predictive Segmentation' pricing line item, and chat-based campaign creation. None of it documents an agent turning a plain-language audience description into a real segment programmatically, and no segment-creation endpoint is evidenced. Campaign creation from chat and generic API access are adjacent capabilities that do not transfer to this segmentation story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface
